sites.tag_type: short epitope, ALFA 15 aa or 3xFLAG equivalent, GS linkers
sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: Non-permeabilized antibody labeling confirmed extracellular surface display of the FLAG tag; the 3F-NHE6-HA construct was used as a functional tool to study endosomal pH regulation and NHE6 trafficking — function preserved.
sites.rationale: Residue 53 = M, residue 54 = D, matching the paper's explicit statement 'after residue Met 53'. Position 53 falls within the first extracellular span (EC1 = 43–70), 11 residues from the signal-peptide cleavage site (SP ends at 42) and 18 residues from the TM1 boundary (TM1 starts at 71), both well above the ≥3-residue minimum. The tag is inserted into the mature extracellular protein, not within the cleaved signal peptide. A triple FLAG epitope (AAA-DYKDDDDK-G-DYKDDDDK-G-DYKDDDDK-AAA) was inserted into full-length, membrane-anchored NHE6 immediately after Met53 in the first extracellular loop, generating the 3F-NHE6-HA construct. The construct was expressed in mammalian cells, the FLAG tag was accessible to antibody without permeabilization (confirming extracellular surface display), and the tagged protein was used as a functional tool to study endosomal pH regulation and trafficking. [validation: surface_and_function; position: validated; source: paper; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: The same template (NHE6 HA ) was also used to introduce a triple Flag epitope (AAA DYKDDDDK G DYKDDDDK G DYKDDDDK AAA) in the first extracellular loop immediately after residue Met 53 .

literature_notes: The DOI:10.1101/2023.07.30.551163 ledger clips describe a full-length NHE6 construct with an 'external triple-HA tag' confirmed by non-permeabilized antibody labeling, but neither clip states the insertion residue. Because the ledger rules require a pinnable position, these clips cannot define an independent site; they are cited as corroborating evidence for the first extracellular loop (EC1, residues 43–70) already validated at Met53.

literature_rejected.reason: Ledger clips confirm extracellular surface display of the HA tag on full-length NHE6 but do not state the insertion residue. Cannot pin insert_after_residue; site cannot be independently reported per ledger rules.
